title: A Death in a Museum
prompt: A man wearing a balaclava runs out of a museum carrying a painting under his arm. A police officer sees him, shoots him dead and soon afterwards kills himself. A couple of days later, the man with the painting is buried and named favorite son of the city.
solution: During a cold spell, a fire broke out in a museum and its director ran out with the most valuable painting in the collection to save it. A police officer who hadn't noticed the fire thought the man was a thief. He ordered him to freeze, but the director was deaf and didn't hear him, so the officer shot him dead. When the officer realized what he had done, he took his own life.
